data.body:
Backend-leaning engineer with nine years building reliable, high-throughput systems. I care about clear interfaces, deterministic behaviour, and tooling that makes the right thing easy.

Comfortable across the stack but happiest designing data pipelines, APIs, and the abstractions that hold a codebase together as it grows.

highlights: Designed a schema-driven document pipeline that cut template maintenance time by 70% across twelve product teams.
Led the migration of the rendering service to a deterministic, browser-free architecture, removing a class of flaky output bugs.
Mentored four engineers; two were promoted within the year.
Built the company's first typed validation layer, reducing production data-shape incidents to near zero.
Owned the public API gateway serving 40M requests/day at p99 latency under 80ms.

items.name: Resgine
items.description: A schema-driven, themeable JSON resume rendering engine with a PDFKit backend.
highlights: Pluggable theme system: themes emit abstract layout nodes, never PDF calls.
Zod-backed validation with JSON Schema export for editor autocomplete.

items.name: Tabulate
items.description: A tiny, deterministic CSV-to-report library used in three internal tools.
